description: Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct with depth-scaled v17 steering: hyper-purified creative @ L19 and technical @ L24, anti-mode prompt-level exclusion, persistent project memory, iterative anti-mode L19 first-token orthogonalization.

layers.note: 3B uses L14/L18 of 36 layers (depth 0.389/0.500). 14B has 48 layers; L19/L24 ≈ depth 0.396/0.500. Adjust via --creative-layer/--technical-layer if a sweep finds a better operating point.

runtime_defaults.iterative_anti_mode_notes: runpod_batch_14b.py captures the first generated token's L19 residual per sample and orthogonalizes the creative vector against the mean prior residual via purify_vector before sample k>=1.

known_caveats: Alpha schedule inherited from 3B Corpius 1; may need re-tuning at 14B once a Vendi sweep is run.
Vector layers L19/L24 are depth-scaled guesses; the right operating layer at 14B is empirical.
Negative bank is 5 modes (verbose/vague/cliche/tangential/overconfident) — smaller than 3B's 12-mode bank.
Frozen-for/promotion-rule fields are deliberately omitted until a 14B benchmark validates the artifact.
